video_title: Denver Nuggets Training Camp Day Five | Practice Media Availability

quotes.speaker: Bryce Hopkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Bryce Hopkins on learning from veteran Nuggets players
quotes.excerpt: just trying to come in, play hard, learn as much as I can from the older guys
quotes.quote: Like you said, it's been my first time. Just trying to come in, play hard, learn as much as I can from the older guys. We have a very established program and veteran guys, so me just trying to learn from them has been the biggest thing for me.
quotes.social_post: Bryce Hopkins says his main focus at Nuggets training camp is learning from the veteran players and understanding the team's established program.

quotes.speaker: Bryce Hopkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Bryce Hopkins on Nikola Jokic's basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokic is a wizard, you know, just sitting back watching him, how he plays, his IQ
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic is a wizard, you know, just sitting back watching him, how he plays, his IQ for the game. But I would probably just say the first unit, their chemistry, how free-flowing the offense is with them.
quotes.social_post: Bryce Hopkins calls Nikola Jokic a wizard and says the most impressive part of watching the Nuggets starters is the free flowing nature of their offense.

quotes.speaker: Bryce Hopkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Bryce Hopkins on seeking advice from Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.excerpt: I probably say Kentavious Caldwell-Pope the most. I was just asking him questions, picking his mind
quotes.quote: I probably say Kentavious Caldwell-Pope the most. I was just asking him questions, picking his mind on, you know, just how was it when he first came into the league, what was he expecting, and how his overall first year went for him.
quotes.social_post: Rookie Bryce Hopkins is leaning on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for advice, picking his brain on what to expect during his first season in the league.

quotes.speaker: Bryce Hopkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope's advice to Bryce Hopkins on the rookie wall
quotes.excerpt: He's basically telling me to take it a day at a time. He says it's going to be a lot
quotes.quote: He's basically telling me to take it a day at a time. He says it's going to be a lot, a lot of information you're going to be coming into with it being your first year. And he told me about the rookie wall that you may hit, you know, getting halfway through the season and whatnot. So me just, you know, trying to be as prepared as possible and trying to get as much information as I can has been big for me.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope is helping Bryce Hopkins prepare for the rookie wall, advising the young guard to take his first season one day at a time.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on learning from veterans in his first NBA camp
quotes.excerpt: It was a lot of learning for me, you know, just learning from the vets, getting a lot of coaching
quotes.quote: It was a lot of learning for me, you know, just learning from the vets, getting a lot of coaching. So, I would say that was the biggest thing, just learning a lot.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile says his first NBA training camp has been a major learning experience as he adjusts to professional coaching and veteran leadership.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on leaning on Aaron Gordon for guidance
quotes.excerpt: Aaron Gordon plays the four spot, so, you know, I got a lot of questions for him
quotes.quote: Aaron Gordon plays the four spot, so, you know, I got a lot of questions for him, offensively and defensively. So, you know, he's kept me up to speed with everything.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile is looking to Aaron Gordon for guidance, noting that he has plenty of questions for the veteran forward regarding his play at the four spot.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on the physical nature of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: This is a whole different league, you know, this isn't college no more, so just going to be more physical
quotes.quote: This is a whole different league, you know, this isn't college no more, so just going to be more physical, more competitive.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile is adjusting to the intensity of the NBA, noting that the league is much more physical and competitive than the college game.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on the high skill level of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: Guys are just way more skilled, you know, obviously better players. There's a reason that these guys are pros
quotes.quote: Guys are just way more skilled, you know, obviously better players. There's a reason that these guys are pros. So, you know, when you actually get here and see it, you realize why, and that's probably the biggest difference.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile says the biggest difference in the NBA is the skill level of the players, noting that you realize why these guys are pros once you get on the court with them.
